page: Google Cloud Platform n4-highmem-8 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The memory configuration consists of 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The CPU is equipped with a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

Benchmark data shows average performance across most compute and memory operations. The server achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1815.0 and a multi-core score of 6984.0. Its memory bandwidth is measured at 542.3 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 61.99 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Text processing is a notable strength, scoring 2350.0 in Geekbench, which falls into the top 25% of tested servers.

Tradeoffs are evident in multi-threaded decompression and large-model LLM inference. The bzip3 multi-threaded decompression score of 36.86 GB/sec is categorized as weak, and text generation using a medium 7B LLM model is poor at 6.1 tokens/sec. However, with its high memory density and average database operations score of 4891.5 on Passmark, this server is configured for memory-intensive workloads such as caching layers, database hosting, and text processing pipelines that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
